+function Get-TaskForgeStatistics {
+    param([AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Tasks = @())
+
+    $invariant = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture
+    $total = @($Tasks).Count
+    $completed = @($Tasks | Where-Object { $_.status -eq 'completed' }).Count
+    $pending = $total - $completed
+
+    $percentage = if ($total -eq 0) { [double]0.0 } else { [math]::Round(($completed / $total) * 100, 1) }
+
+    $counts = [ordered]@{}
+    foreach ($task in @($Tasks)) {
+        $parsed = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse(
+            [string]$task.createdAt,
+            $invariant,
+            [System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::RoundtripKind)
+        $date = $parsed.UtcDateTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd', $invariant)
+        if ($counts.Contains($date)) { $counts[$date] = [int]$counts[$date] + 1 } else { $counts[$date] = 1 }
+    }
+
+    $byDate = @(
+        $counts.Keys | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object {
+            [pscustomobject][ordered]@{ date = [string]$_; count = [int]$counts[$_] }
+        }
+    )
+
+    return [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+        total = [int]$total
+        pending = [int]$pending
+        completed = [int]$completed
+        completionPercentage = [double]$percentage
+        byDate = $byDate
+    }
+}
+
+function Format-TaskForgeStatistics {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$Statistics)
+
+    $invariant = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture
+    $lines = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
+    $lines.Add("Total tasks: $($Statistics.total)")
+    $lines.Add("Pending: $($Statistics.pending)")
+    $lines.Add("Completed: $($Statistics.completed)")
+    $lines.Add("Completion: $(([double]$Statistics.completionPercentage).ToString('0.0', $invariant))%")
+    $lines.Add('Created by date:')
+    if (@($Statistics.byDate).Count -eq 0) {
+        $lines.Add('  (none)')
+    }
+    else {
+        foreach ($entry in $Statistics.byDate) {
+            $lines.Add("  $($entry.date): $($entry.count)")
+        }
+    }
+    return ($lines -join "`n")
+}

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    # --- stats command ---
    $statsFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'stats.json'

    # Empty storage: zeros and an empty date list.
    $emptyStats = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($emptyStats.ExitCode -eq 0) 'stats should succeed on empty storage'
    $emptyStatsData = $emptyStats.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($emptyStatsData.total -eq 0 -and $emptyStatsData.pending -eq 0 -and $emptyStatsData.completed -eq 0) 'empty stats should report zeros'
    Assert-True ($emptyStatsData.completionPercentage -eq 0.0) 'empty stats completion should be 0.0'
    Assert-True (@($emptyStatsData.byDate).Count -eq 0) 'empty stats should have an empty date list'
    Assert-True (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $statsFile)) 'stats must not create storage for empty input'

    # Controlled storage across multiple UTC calendar dates with mixed statuses.
    $controlled = @'
[
  { "id": 1, "title": "A", "description": "", "status": "completed", "createdAt": "2026-01-02T10:00:00.0000000+00:00" },
  { "id": 2, "title": "B", "description": "", "status": "pending",   "createdAt": "2026-01-02T11:00:00.0000000+00:00" },
  { "id": 3, "title": "C", "description": "", "status": "completed", "createdAt": "2026-01-03T23:30:00.0000000+00:00" },
  { "id": 4, "title": "D", "description": "", "status": "pending",   "createdAt": "2026-01-04T01:00:00.0000000+05:00" }
]
'@
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($statsFile, "$controlled`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $before = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($statsFile)

    $stats = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($stats.ExitCode -eq 0) 'stats should succeed on populated storage'
    $statsData = $stats.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($statsData.total -eq 4 -and $statsData.pending -eq 2 -and $statsData.completed -eq 2) 'stats should count total/pending/completed'
    Assert-True ($statsData.completionPercentage -eq 50.0) 'stats completion percentage should be 50.0'
    $dates = @($statsData.byDate)
    Assert-True ($dates.Count -eq 2) 'stats should group into two UTC dates'
    Assert-True ($dates[0].date -eq '2026-01-02' -and $dates[0].count -eq 2) 'first date group should be 2026-01-02 with 2'
    Assert-True ($dates[1].date -eq '2026-01-03' -and $dates[1].count -eq 2) 'second date group should be 2026-01-03 with 2 (UTC conversion)'

    $after = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($statsFile)
    Assert-True ($before -eq $after) 'stats must never rewrite storage'

    # Rounding to one decimal with invariant formatting (1 of 3 completed => 33.3).
    $roundFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'round.json'
    $roundData = @'
[
  { "id": 1, "title": "A", "description": "", "status": "completed", "createdAt": "2026-02-01T10:00:00.0000000+00:00" },
  { "id": 2, "title": "B", "description": "", "status": "pending",   "createdAt": "2026-02-01T11:00:00.0000000+00:00" },
  { "id": 3, "title": "C", "description": "", "status": "pending",   "createdAt": "2026-02-01T12:00:00.0000000+00:00" }
]
'@
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($roundFile, "$roundData`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $round = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $roundFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ((($round.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).completionPercentage) -eq 33.3) 'completion percentage should round to 33.3'

    # Non-JSON output shows the banner before the dashboard; JSON output is banner-free.
    $statsText = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsFile)
    Assert-True ($statsText.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON stats should succeed'
    Assert-True ($statsText.Output.Contains('STATS')) 'non-JSON stats should include the STATS banner'
    Assert-True ($statsText.Output.Contains('Total tasks: 4')) 'non-JSON stats should include the dashboard'
    $bannerIndex = $statsText.Output.IndexOf('STATS')
    $dashboardIndex = $statsText.Output.IndexOf('Total tasks:')
    Assert-True ($bannerIndex -ge 0 -and $bannerIndex -lt $dashboardIndex) 'banner should appear before the dashboard'
    Assert-True (-not $stats.Output.Contains('STATS')) 'JSON stats output should be banner-free'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 8 base fixture assertions + stats command assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
